name: The Maqam Ledger
beat: Arabic and world music, with a focus on artists blending traditional maqam with contemporary and classical styles.
audience: Listeners and musicians interested in Arabic music traditions and fusion.
likes: Fusion projects, traditional training meeting new forms, artists who can explain their musical choices.

name: Gulf Stage Weekly
beat: Concerts, festivals, venue openings and live performances across the Gulf.
audience: Concert-goers and event planners in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and neighbouring countries.
likes: Upcoming shows with dates and venues, first-of-their-kind performances, visiting and resident artists.

name: Diaspora Voices
beat: Personal stories of people who moved countries and how migration shapes their identity, work and culture.
audience: Readers interested in migration, belonging and cultural identity.
likes: Strong personal narratives, before-and-after stories, artists building careers far from home.

name: Second Act Magazine
beat: People who changed careers to follow a creative passion, and what it took.
audience: Professionals considering a career change and people curious about unconventional paths.
likes: Career pivots with concrete turning points, practical lessons, honest accounts of risk.

name: Strings & Bows Quarterly
beat: Classical and orchestral music, string instruments, conservatory training and technique.
audience: Classical musicians, students and serious listeners.
likes: Conservatory-trained performers, technique and repertoire discussions, new takes on the classical tradition.

name: The Wedding Circuit
type: Wedding and private events trade publication
beat: The wedding and private events industry: entertainment vendors, trends and planning.
audience: Wedding planners, venues and couples hiring live entertainment.
likes: Live music for weddings and private events, trends in entertainment, vendor spotlights.

name: Emirates Arts Digest
beat: Galleries, exhibition openings, art fairs and cultural institutions in the UAE.
audience: Art lovers, gallery-goers and cultural professionals.
likes: Performances tied to gallery and exhibition events, collaborations between music and visual art.

name: Cross-Genre Radio
beat: Conversations with musicians who blend genres and traditions.
audience: Curious listeners who enjoy hearing how artists think about their craft.
likes: Guests with a clear story about mixing traditions, collaborations across cultures, strong anecdotes.

name: Women in Sound
beat: Women musicians, producers and engineers, and representation in the music industry.
audience: Industry professionals and aspiring women in music.
likes: Profiles of women building music careers, industry barriers and how they were overcome.

name: Tech & Tempo
beat: Where technology meets music: AI tools, software, production and new instruments.
audience: Producers, developers and technologists interested in music.
likes: Musicians who also build software, AI-assisted music projects, opinions on technology in creative work.

name: Dubai Neighbourhood Post
beat: Local events, residents' stories and community happenings in Dubai neighbourhoods.
audience: Dubai residents looking for things to do and local stories.
likes: Local performers, free or community events, stories about people who live and work nearby.

name: Levant Culture Desk
beat: Culture, music and arts from Syria, Lebanon, Jordan and Palestine and their diasporas.
audience: Readers connected to or interested in Levantine culture.
likes: Artists from the Levant working abroad, keeping traditions alive, cultural bridges between countries.
